title: BASINSHIFT forecast record (BASINSHIFT 8.3)
description: One JSON object per line (JSON Lines, gzip) for each (catchment, forecast origin). Arrays are aligned with forecast_horizons_days. Additional checks that a JSON Schema cannot express (unknown ids, duplicates, missing keys, lower <= upper, extreme <= high probability) are enforced by src/submission.py validate().

catchment_id.description: Caravan gauge id; always a string

forecast_origin.description: End of day t (UTC convention); inputs use data up to and including day t

predicted_discharge.description: Point forecast of flow on day t+h, mm/day

high_flow_probability.description: P(flow on day t+h > basin's 95th percentile flow, 1981-10..2008-09)

extreme_flow_probability.description: P(flow on day t+h > basin's 99th percentile flow); <= high_flow_probability
